DEF-P22-009 (owner P04): iam.api.base.SecuredView/ModuleSecuredView open the request's tenant scope (tenancy.activate + transaction.atomic + SET LOCAL binding) in initial() and close it only in finalize_response(), which DRF skips when an unhandled exception escapes the handler: the transaction block and the activated tenant context leak onto the connection/thread, and when the garbage collector later finalises the suspended scope its Atomic.__exit__ runs on the collecting thread's connection (ADR-003, invariant 12)

DEF-P22-003 (owner P01): GET /api/v1/schema answers 200 to anonymous callers (drf-spectacular SERVE_PERMISSIONS defaults to AllowAny); only health/live, health/ready and system/environment may be anonymous (D-ALL 1, D-P01)
DEF-P22-002 (owner P04): anonymous API requests answer 403 without WWW-Authenticate; the contract declares 401 Unauthorized (problem+json) for every protected operation

DEF-P22-005 (owner P02): role template 'vendedor' reads inventory items with standard_cost (confidential) and valuation_method: S1 step 7 requires that vendedor1@A sees no cost fields (API, export, report, AI, MCP)
DEF-P22-006 (owner P02): role template 'vendedor' has no sales.invoice.read (own customers): S1 step 7 requires that vendedor1@A sees the invoice of an own customer

DEF-P22-008 (owner P01): kernel.parameters.enforce raises ParameterUnknown(..., code=<parameter code>): the keyword overwrites the error code, so the problem+json type becomes '.../smmlv.2027' instead of '.../parameter_unknown' and callers cannot recognise the fail-closed error (C1-9)
